articles.title: Ethereum startup EthSystems bets privacy is key to getting banks on public blockchains
articles.snippet: EthSystems, which spun out of the Ethereum Foundation earlier this month, is focused on building privacy infrastructure for banks and other financial institutions.

articles.title: Hyperliquid is taking crypto perps deep into DeFi’s ‘money LEGO’ land
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid is capitalizing on the volume and depth of its order book by giving firms the option to compose with the platform’s shared liquidity, rather than fragmenting it.

articles.title: Hong Kong’s central bank puts a number on lenders' quantum preparedness. It's very low.
articles.snippet: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority published a whitepaper on the quantum preparedness of Hong Kong’s banking industry and its first Quantum Preparedness Index.

articles.title: Binance phishes its own staff monthly, India censors BitChat code: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Binance has been phishing its own staff to get ahead of potential attacks. South Korean crypto volumes tank 89% — plus all of the week’s other crypto news from Asia.

articles.title: Cross River to enable P2P payments, banking services for X Money
articles.snippet: The banking-as-a-service provider will power X Money’s peer-to-peer payments, FDIC-insured accounts and Visa debit cards as the platform expands its financial services.
